CI run 37928629998 ran codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=4 on the extracted bundle: exit 1, "Payload/pool.app: invalid Info.plist (plist or signature have been modified)". Main executable LC_CODE_SIGNATURE is PRESENT with a CMS chain rooted at "Apple iPhone OS Application Signing" (genuine App Store provenance), and LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO_64 is PRESENT with cryptid=0 (FairPlay decrypted). The injected Frameworks/libloader.framework/libloader has NO LC_CODE_SIGNATURE. Info.plist carries DecryptedBy = "@FastDecryptBot - https://t.me/FastDecryptBot", which is what breaks the seal. embedded.mobileprovision is absent everywhere, so the bundle is not installable as-is. Resource seal audit: 3,312 matching / 49 mismatching files2 entries (6,624 / 98 hash comparisons) and 61 missing SC_Info FairPlay artifacts.
